criteria.notes: The menu handles editable structured courses, uneven categories, paging, static fallback, long labels, and realistic service states.

Generated identity assets and light and dark menu surfaces are complete, coordinated, and package-safe.
Compared with all nine other maintained examples; composition, pagination, hierarchy, and visual language remain distinct.
